newsitem.title: CANADA: Ault board okays Parmalat bid.
newsitem.headline: Ault board okays Parmalat bid.

text.p: Dairy foods firm Ault Foods Ltd said on Friday that its board of directors recommended shareholders accept a C$34 per share offer from white knight Parmalat Finanziaria SpA of Italy.
Parmalat's bid, which topped a C$28 a share bid by privately held Saputo Group Inc, was considered "fair" and "in the best interests of Ault," the board said in a statement.
Italy's largest listed food company made a C$415 million offer on June 9, which expires on July 3.
Ault's board said that "the Parmalat offer represents a 21 percent premium over the consideration offered under the Saputo offer."
Shares in Toronto-based Ault were flat at 34.10 in extremely light trading in Toronto on Friday.
Parmalat closed almost flat at 2471 lire on Milan's equities exchange today.
Saputo Executive Vice President Camillo Lisio said late on Thursday that the Montreal-based firm was negotiating access to Ault's data room.
Saputo has said it would consider raising its offer if it got access to the data.
